title: Voice Assistant
micHint: Hold to speak an invoice, payment, or balance query
unrecognized: Could not understand speech. Please try again.
notAvailable: On-device speech recognition is not available for this language.
permissionDenied: Microphone or speech recognition permission was denied.

errors.PERMISSION_REQUESTED: Microphone allowed. Now hold the button and speak.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: VoiceLedger cannot use the microphone. Allow it in your phone's Settings → Apps → VoiceLedger → Permissions.
errors.LANGUAGE_NOT_INSTALLED: The offline speech pack for this language is not on your phone yet.
errors.NO_SPEECH: Didn't hear anything. Hold the button while you speak, then let go.
errors.MIC_BUSY: Another app is using the microphone. Close it and try again.
errors.NOT_AVAILABLE: This phone has no offline speech recognition. You can type the sale instead.
errors.UNKNOWN: Could not understand speech. Please try again.

languagePackMessage: Voice works offline once the speech pack for this language is downloaded. This is a one-time download by your phone.
languagePackRequested: Download started. When it finishes, hold the button and speak.
languagePackUnavailable: This phone cannot download the speech pack. Open Settings → Google → Speech to add the language, or type the sale instead.
